opening_message: My bank cancelled a debit card because of a negative debt record, and a firm is also chasing me for a CHF 380 parcel-delivery invoice. I dispute only CHF 45 of the added charges. I can check both the register named by the bank and what kind of letter the firm sent.
hidden_facts: The bank points to the official Betreibungsregister and the debt there remains disputed. The firm sent an ordinary collection-agency reminder, not a formal payment order. Total CHF 380, of which CHF 45 in extra fees is disputed.

gold.justification: Two separate covered domains are present: collection charges and a record affecting access to banking services. The model must not merge them into a single event or ignore the data-source distinction. With both source and document verified, the gate may proceed.
